instruction.text: Damon erzählt von seinem Taschengeld. Lies den Text und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: I started to get pocket money when I was 7 years old. When I was in primary school, I used to get my pocket money once a week. Now that I am in secondary school, I get it once a month. My older sister Clara gets £30, since she is 14 years old. And my younger brother Jonah gets £16, as he is only 10 years old. I get £21, because I am 12 years old.

atoms.text: In the past I used to buy lots of candy with my pocket money. I also often bought toys. Now, I mainly buy CDs, books and video games. Or I buy tickets for the cinema and other activities. I never had to buy clothes or school supplies with my pocket money. I can't wait to get older, so that I can get more pocket money and buy more stuff.
